title: Salon Marketing: 2026 Guide to Ideas, Plans & Strategies for Hair & Beauty

facts.fact: Booksy states that Reserve with Google lets clients book appointments directly from Google Search or Maps in under 30 seconds.
facts.quote: Use **Reserve with Google** to allow clients to book directly from Search and Maps in under 30 seconds.

facts.fact: Booksy's blog states that over 90% of consumers check reviews before trying a new stylist; the chunk gives no third-party source for this figure.
facts.quote: Over **90% of consumers** check reviews before trying a new stylist.

facts.fact: Booksy states that its software automatically prompts clients to leave a review after their appointment.
facts.quote: Booksy automatically prompts clients to leave reviews after their appointment

facts.fact: This Booksy salon marketing guide was published on May 6, 2024.
Booksy's example referral offer gives the existing client $20 off their next service and the new friend 20% off their first visit.
facts.quote: For example, give your regular client $20 off their next service while offering the new friend 20% off their first visit.

facts.fact: Booksy suggests offering exclusive perks such as early access to holiday booking slots to its top 10% of spenders.
facts.quote: Offer exclusive perks to your top 10% of spenders, such as early access to holiday booking slots

facts.fact: Booksy suggests targeting Meta ads for a bridal styling service at newly engaged women within a 10-mile radius of the salon.
facts.quote: you can put your "Bridal Styling" ad specifically in front of newly engaged women within a 10-mile radius of your salon.

facts.fact: Email marketing returns an average of $38 for every $1 spent in the beauty industry, according to Booksy's blog.
facts.quote: Email remains the king of ROI in the beauty industry, returning an average of **$38 for every $1 spent**.

facts.fact: SMS messages have open rates near 98%, according to Booksy's blog.
facts.quote: With open rates near 98%, [text messaging]

facts.fact: Over 80% of salon bookings happen on mobile devices, according to Booksy's blog.
facts.quote: Over **80% of salon bookings** happen on mobile devices.

facts.fact: Booksy's blog recommends sending automated SMS or email rebooking reminders to clients who have not rebooked in-salon, to catch them 48 hours later.
facts.quote: If a client doesn't rebook in-salon, use automated SMS or email reminders through **Booksy** to catch them 48 hours later.

facts.fact: Booksy's blog suggests sending birthday offers automatically seven days before a client's birthday.
facts.quote: Automate a special offer (like a complimentary luxury treatment) to be sent seven days before a [client's birthday]

facts.fact: Booksy's blog suggests a win-back 'We Miss You' trigger that fires if a client has not booked in 12 weeks.
facts.quote: If a client hasn't booked in 12 weeks, the system automatically sends a "Come back and see us" incentive

facts.fact: Booksy's blog says a standard marketing budget for a healthy salon is 3% to 7% of total gross revenue.
facts.quote: a standard marketing budget is **3% to 7% of your total gross revenue**.

facts.fact: Booksy's blog says a salon in a heavy growth phase or opening a new location may temporarily scale its marketing budget up to 10% of gross revenue.
facts.quote: you may need to scale up to **10%** temporarily.

facts.fact: Booksy's blog states that with Reserve with Google connected through Booksy, a client can go from searching to booked in under 30 seconds.
facts.quote: This allows a client to go from searching to booked in under 30 seconds

facts.fact: Booksy's blog suggests a 'Flash Slot' SMS blast to a 'Top 50' client list to fill last-minute cancellations.
facts.quote: an automated SMS blast to your "Top 50" clients can fill that chair in minutes.

facts.fact: Booksy's blog recommends a 30-day salon marketing plan in which Days 1–7 cover claiming the Google Business Profile, syncing it with Booksy, and updating the service menu.
facts.quote: Use this 30-day roadmap to build your marketing engine piece by piece.

facts.fact: According to Booksy data, engaged loyalty members visit salons 2.4x more often.
facts.quote: According to Booksy data, engaged loyalty members visit **2.4x more often**.
